text:
lee_h: FYI telemetry spiked after pushing engine-bundle-2026-06-tiler to regional micro-canary. p95 up ~40% on long tails and 1 OOM on g3-eu-05.

toni_k: which feature in that bundle? tiler + new kv-compact allocator right?

lee_h: yep. bundle tag `2026-06-tiler-compactv1`, rolled to 0.8% in eu-west. spike started 03:12.

sam_r: that allocator introduced aggressive chunk coalescing. bench looked good for seq<=2k. sounds like fragmentation with >6k.

release-coordinator: mitigation options: pause rollout, pin to previous stable, or flip feature-flag to fallback. hosted canary has no remote flag. fastest is pause+pin.

deply_typo: (bot typo)
deploybot: action available: `pin-version --target=eu-west-micro-canary --version=2026-05-tiler-stable --ttl=4h`

lee_h: recommend pin for 4h. ops, can you run a focused smoke with seqlens 6k/12k and collect mem/p95/p99 and warmpaths?

opsbot: queued: `ops smoke --bundle 2026-06-tiler-compactv1 --nodes=4 --seqlens=6144,12288 --dur=420 --collect=mem,p95,p99,ooms,warms`. ETA ~8m.

opsbot: smoke results: 6144 -> p95 +15% mem +9% no OOMs; 12288 -> p95 +47% mem +39% 1 OOM on g3-eu-05 and 2 failed warmstarts. logs: https://internal.run/smoke/2876543210

ton i_k: reproduces on 12k. pin it.

lee_h: executing pin now: `pin-version --target=eu-west-micro-canary --version=2026-05-tiler-stable --ttl=4h --reason="OOMs on long sequences with compactv1"`

deploybot: executed: pin successful. routing updated; weights reverted. Notification: routing change will take ~45s to fully propagate.

sam_r: ill prepare a debug variant disabling chunk coalescing and enabling early-kv-free. will add perf snapshots and a longer long-tail harness (20m).

release-coordinator: notes for release log (internal): "Paused micro-canary for 2026-06-tiler-compactv1 due to memory pressure on extreme sequence lengths; reverted to previous stable build while debug patch is prepared." Public line: "Limited canary paused due to edge-case memory growth on very long requests; no broad impact observed."

toni_k: next actions: (1) debug build PR with coalescing off, (2) create runtime feature flag to toggle allocator fallback for hosted builds, (3) run extended long-tail CI before re-roll.

opsbot: monitoring subscribed. will alert if OOM >0 or p95 > baseline *1.25 for 10m.

lee_h: leaving pin TTL 4h to allow triage and retest. closing thread for now.
